Pronunciation and Status

发音与身份 · 233 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1An ambassador and a referee were asking a professor about the caption on a Buddhist alphabet chart when a sobbing woman stopped them and tried to sell them an antique musical bathtub. Her dirty garment and the handkerchief around her waist badly needed to be taken to a laundry. The ambassador felt uncomfortable and gave her a handful of pennies from his wallet and said, “Take this fortune and go away, you troublesome woman.”

2After she had disappeared from view, the brilliant professor said, “You were mistaken, and your remark about her was out of line. She is an extraordinary woman. You can’t judge her social status by her shabby clothes or dirty nails. Her clean woolen vest and stockings, especially her precise pronunciation, suggested that she held an important position.” The ambassador gave a whistle of amazement and suggested making her acquaintance. The professor hesitated for a while, then agreed.

3She turned out to be a senior police officer. When they were shown into her office and saw her again, she brought them a teapot of tea and some cookies, laughing and saying, “I rubbed some cream and wax on my garment and passed myself off as a shabby woman among thieves and robbers to investigate a plot. Generally speaking, it helped that I had adapted to their world and that you overlooked me. But my pronunciation seemed to have betrayed me.”

发音与身份

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一名大使和一位裁判正在向教授请教佛教字母表上一条题注的意思。这时，一个抽泣的女人叫住了他们，想卖给他们一只会发出音乐的古董浴缸。她身上的衣服和系在腰间的手帕脏得非送洗不可。大使觉得不自在，从钱包里掏出几枚便士递给她，说：“拿着这笔大钱走吧，真麻烦。”

2她的身影消失后，才智出众的教授说：“你看错了，那样评价她也不妥。这位女士很不寻常，怎么能只凭破旧的衣服和脏指甲来判断她的身份？她干净的羊毛背心和长袜，尤其是她那标准的发音，都表明她的身份并不一般。”大使惊讶地吹了声口哨，提议去结识她。教授犹豫了一会儿，最终同意了。

3结果，她真是一名高级警官。两人被领进她的办公室，再次见到她时，她给他们端来一壶茶和一些饼干，笑着说：“我往衣服上涂了些奶油和蜡，把自己装扮成衣着寒酸的女人，混进小偷和劫匪中间调查一桩阴谋。我能适应那种环境，你们又没留意到我，这些都帮了大忙。可我的发音好像还是暴露了我。”
